posts.zh:
dsh-chat-history 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。在会话头部新增「目录」tab：把当前会话的用户消息整理成可点击的目录，自动翻页加载全部历史，点击即跳回对话并定位。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-124dada74576f89a5e34.html
posts.en:
dsh-chat-history is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Adds a "History" conversation view tab listing the session's user messages as a clickable directory, with auto-paging and click-to-jump back into the chat.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-124dada74576f89a5e34.html
